extensionData.description: Provider-specific usage values that must round-trip without interpretation. Runtimes project only numeric integral values representable by their usage-count type and ignore other values when constructing runtime usage objects.

dataContent.description: The content of a message exchanged with the agent.

uri.description: The URI that comprises the data.

mediaType.description: The media type of the data.

errorContent.description: The error content of a message exchanged with the agent.

hostedFileContent.description: The hosted file content of a message exchanged with the agent.

fileId.description: The identifier of the hosted file.

hostedVectorStoreContent.description: The hosted vector store content of a message exchanged with the agent.

vectorStoreId.description: The identifier of the hosted vector store.

textReasoningContent.description: The reasoning content of a message exchanged with the agent.

uriContent.description: The URI content of a message exchanged with the agent.

mediaType.description: The media type of the URI.

usageContent.description: The usage content of a message exchanged with the agent.

textContent.description: The text content of a message exchanged with the agent.

text.description: The text content of the message.

functionCallContent.description: The function call content of a message exchanged with the agent.

callId.description: The identifier of the function being called.

name.description: The name of the function being called.

arguments.description: The arguments provided to the function call.

functionResultContent.description: The function result content of a message exchanged with the agent.

callId.description: The identifier of the function being called.

result.description: The result returned by the function call.

unknownContent.description: The unknown content of a message exchanged with the agent. The content value is opaque and producers and consumers must preserve its fields without interpreting generic payload properties such as $runtimeType. The namespaced $microsoftAgentFrameworkDurableTask property is reserved for a versioned, non-operative durable-extension metadata envelope; it never identifies or requests construction of a runtime type.

content.description: The opaque unknown message content serialized as JSON.

chatMessage.description: Single chat message exchanged with the agent.

authorName.description: The name of the author of the message.

contents.description: The message content. An empty array is a valid metadata-only message.

messageId.description: Stable identity for this message. Assigned by the runtime when the producer left it unset.

extensionData.description: Message-level additional properties that must round-trip without interpretation.

correlationId.description: An optional correlation ID to group related exchanges.

extensionData.description: Entry-level additional properties that must round-trip without interpretation.

agentRequest.description: The request (i.e. prompt) sent to the agent.

orchestrationId.description: The identifier of the orchestration that initiated this agent request (if any).

responseSchema.description: If the expected response type is JSON, this schema defines the expected structure of the response.

responseType.description: The expected type of the response (e.g., 'text', 'json').

agentResponse.description: The response received from the agent.

agentErrorResponse.description: A failed turn. Consumers must not replay it to the model.

compaction.description: A compacted transcript message written by a compatible runtime. It answers no request and has no correlation ID.

session.description: Opaque runtime-defined serialized session; this schema layer does not interpret it.

ingestedPositions.description: Highest chained-conversation position this entity has taken from each workflow executor, keyed by executor id. The .NET workflow path preserves but does not currently populate these watermarks.

truncation.description: Producer-supplied bounded evidence that messages were removed from this conversation.

extensionData.description: Data-level additional properties that must round-trip without interpretation.

schemaVersion.description: Numeric SemVer core version of this state schema (major.minor.patch only, without leading zeroes, prerelease, or build metadata). By convention, this should be the first property.

extensionData.description: Root-level additional properties that must round-trip without interpretation.
